title: CommunityPulseWriteRequest
description: community.pulse-write-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/pulse/items on OpenVibe.Community (community.pulse.write; service tokens only): an item about one of the calling service's own entities (ref.service must be that service: 403 pulse.foreign_ref otherwise), with a title (whitespace collapsed, 1 to 300 characters) and an absolute http(s) url (at most 2000 characters). origin defaults to X-OV-Origin (user, ai or system; X-OV-Origin: ai always wins); an origin user item names the person in X-OV-Subject. occurred_at is an ISO time, not in the future (default now). Only public activity enters Pulse: a visibility other than public is 400 pulse.not_public. The same ref again updates the item. Unknown fields are ignored. DELETE /api/v1/pulse/items/:service/:type/:id takes no body.

title.description: At most 300 characters once whitespace is collapsed.
